parameters.name: DeploymentId
parameters.description: The deployment order ID. You can call the [QueryEdgeInstanceHistoricDeployment](~~135275~~) operation to obtain the ID.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The edge instance ID. On the **Edge Instances** page of the [Link IoT Edge console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), hover over the target edge instance name to obtain the ID.

You can also call the [QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~) operation to obtain the ID.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID. Leave this parameter empty for the public instance. Specify this parameter for Enterprise instances.
